title: Naturalization - travel and continuous residence
facts: Trips outside the United States can affect continuous residence and physical presence for naturalization.
An absence of more than 6 months but less than 1 year may create a presumption that continuous residence was disrupted.
An absence of 1 year or more generally breaks continuous residence, subject to statutory exceptions and preservation rules.
A reentry permit by itself does not preserve continuous residence for naturalization.
